notes: *again* is יָסַף's own word under rule 56's auxiliary-verb clause, with *did* left to the infinitive; the לְ before that infinitive is unrepresented because the ASV writes no function word for it (rule 52).
Every *the* before a *gods* is supplied on the construct, no article morpheme standing in those chains; the two written articles are on הַבְּעָלִים and הָעַשְׁתָּרוֹת (rule 29).
The Hebrew marginal gloss *Aram* was read and set aside; the printed *Syria* governs (rule 38).
